metadata.title: Thesis-Aligned Evaluation Set
metadata.thesis: Integrating Urdu Language with AI Agent for Intelligent Database Querying
metadata.design: 9 thesis-defined query categories × 3 meaning-equivalent intents × 3 languages = 81 paired core tests
important: Core categories and metrics follow the thesis only.
Gold SQL is compared by database result equivalence, not exact SQL text.
Safety, voice, session/authentication and diagnostic cases are reported separately.
